text:
sana: just merged PR #8421 into main, main pipeline turned red immediately. smoke-gpu and smoke-kv-integration failing :grimacing: CI: https://ci.redwood.example/runs/3098765420
ben: @sana can you revert? or should we rerun first?
jamie: pinging @oncall for quick triage. anyone grabbing first responder?
ci-bot: Build failed on step `smoke-kv-integration` with exit code 1. Logs: https://ci.redwood.example/logs/3098765420/step-smoke-kv. Rerun allowed.
alex: I'll take first responder. starting quick rerun now.
lina: quick note — PR #8421 touched kvcache eviction TTL and autoscaler config, could explain intermittent flip.
alex: rerun started... `rerun #2` kicked off.
ci-bot: Rerun #2 completed — most steps green but `smoke-kv-integration` still failing in shard 3.
ben: can we grab the failing shard logs and stacktrace?
alex: attaching top error snippet: ```ERROR: eviction mismatch: expected prefix length 64 got 0 at kv_store.cc:413```
jamie: :eyes: that looks like a serialization/zero-length prefix bug when TTL is zeroed. @sana did your change set TTL to 0 anywhere?
sana: I added `ttl = maybe_get_ttl()` which returns 0 when not configured. thought zero meant 'unset' — can be wrong.
devex: note — docs indicate TTL=0 means immediate eviction, I'll open a docs PR to clarify.
lina: ok if TTL=0 causes immediate eviction then kvcache smoke will flake. we should revert or hotfix to treat 0 as 'unset'.
alex: quick triage proposal: revert PR #8421 to unblock main, follow up with a fix and tests. who can author the revert?
sana: I'll open the revert now and link it.
alex: agree, do revert, then I'll run full matrix once revert merges.
sana: revert PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/8430 — cc @alex @ben
ci-bot: Pull request #8430 merged into main by sana.
ci-bot: New pipeline triggered for commit abc123 (revert).
ci-bot: Pipeline passed on main. All smoke and kvcache steps green.
jamie: nice. marking this thread resolved but create a follow-up to fix TTL handling.
ben: filing follow-up issue #1294 assigned to sana.
sana: assigned and will work on fix + tests tomorrow.
alex: thanks all. please ping if it flaps again.
